purpose: Display-only distinction between existing major buildings and smaller context. No geometry or project status is changed. Native architectural materials are retained.
caveat: Large-envelope criteria use source bounding rectangles for visual emphasis; they are not surveyed floor area or a land-use classification. Merged source faces are tested individually, so an entire tile of houses is never shaded as one large building.
coordinateAxes: x east; y relative elevation; z south
